limitations: This inventory was read once on October 16, 2026 for the comparison pilot. It is not served on the website and does not refresh. It uses the packaged Feeds source directory format so that the existing parser checks it.
A list position, star count, vote count or review count is a popularity signal at the read time, not evidence of quality, adoption or a qualified component.
Reading a source does not grant permission to copy its code, data or text. Each repository's licence and each competition's rules apply to the exact item.

sources.name: CodeRabbit open-source review leaderboard, September 2026
sources.description: CodeRabbit's post of October 8, 2026 by Santosh Yadav. It reports 1,049,817 completed reviews on open-source repositories in September 2026 and ranks the ten public repositories with the most: stablyai/orca 5,629, pingdotgg/t3code 3,856, manaflow-ai/cmux 3,475, Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend 2,699, lidge-jun/opencodex 2,375, oven-sh/bun 1,751, infiniflow/ragflow 1,667, vllm-project/vllm 1,516, pnpm/pnpm 1,476 and jdx/mise 1,386. Counts include repeat reviews of the same pull request.
sources.access: Public blog page with no API, read on October 16, 2026. Only the top three entries link their repositories.
sources.reuse: The page states no reuse terms beyond a CodeRabbit copyright notice. Keep project names, counts and the link as facts; do not copy the article. None of the ten fits a small offline pilot task: each is a large application, a TypeScript, Rust or Zig toolchain, or needs a GPU or services.

collections.title: Popular project and task sources
collections.purpose: Find popular open projects and public tasks that can be recreated, repaired or modelled in a clean local workspace, with their own tests or a held-out split as acceptance.
collections.agent_task: Choose candidate tasks by a rule written before any trial and record why each candidate was taken or left.
collections.decision_question: Which popular project or task can be compared with and without Baltor, offline, with acceptance the harness cannot see?
collections.review_trigger: A new leaderboard month, a list revision, a new Getting Started competition or a licence change.

collections.title: Project improvement watch
collections.purpose: Collect dated evidence of releases, models, tools and advisories that could improve a chosen project, for an AgentBriefs brief with a testable experiment.
collections.agent_task: Write a brief that separates evidence, hypothesis and the experiment that would test it.
collections.decision_question: Which recent release, tool or method is worth one bounded experiment on this project, and which is not?
collections.review_trigger: A new release of the project or one of its dependencies, a new advisory or a model directory change.
